items.title: US-Iran deal covers Lebanon, Strait of Hormuz and Iran's uranium
items.description: The presidents of the United States and Iran have officially signed a memorandum of understanding aimed at ending the war and reopening the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Live: US and Iran sign agreement to end war
items.description: The US and Iran have signed a memorandum of understanding to end the war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Follow live.

items.title: Breaking: Vodafone network crash potentially affecting millions of Australians
items.description: A statement from the company says it is aware some customers are experiencing "intermittent issues" with its service and it is urgently investigating.

items.title: Hanson's fiery address creates risk for One Nation
items.description: In one press club appearance, we've learned more about where Hanson stands. And that creates risk for One Nation.

items.title: Couple left with nothing after investing $1m in 7-Eleven franchise
items.description: Jotika and Sunny Sharma took out a loan to purchase their Sydney franchise in 2015. When the lease expired this year, their relationship with the convenience store giant turned ugly.

items.title: 'Find something else': Academics warn of workload as uni rankings released
items.description: Annual university rankings reveal the University of New South Wales is now the highest-rated Australian institution, placing 19th worldwide.

items.title: Walker's breakout Origin performance showed us both sides of his coin
items.description: On Wednesday night, Queensland coach Billy Slater got a glimpse of a glistening Sam Walker-led future, even if the present wasn't quite perfect.

items.title: Wife and carer 'dumbfounded' by husband's aged care assessment
items.description: Melbourne man Graham Crossan relies on his wife Gaynor to help him eat, move and even breathe. But a new assessment tool means he has been refused funding for more support.

items.title: After 27 years, Virginia Trioli takes creative leap and leaves the ABC
items.description: After 27 years as a journalist, broadcaster and program maker at the ABC, Virginia Trioli announces she is leaving to pursue new creative opportunities.

items.title: Live: Ghana struggling against Panama after England's frenetic opening win
items.description: Manchester City star Antoine Semenyo takes the field for Ghana in Toronto, after Harry Kanes nets a brace in England's entertaining 4-2 win over Croatia. Follow live.

items.title: First Australian hantavirus cruise ship passenger speaks from quarantine
items.description: One of the Australians who was onboard the MV Hondius recounts the "huge shock" of a deadly outbreak on the ship, as he looks forward to leaving a Perth quarantine facility and getting a "big hug" from his family.

items.title: Live: ASX to fall as US Federal Reserve leans towards rate hikes
items.description: The ASX is set to open down this morning, with the US Federal Reserve deciding to keep interest rates on hold, but a growing group of committee members predict a rate hike this year.

items.title: HSBC 'gaslit' customers who lost life savings. Now it's fronting court over failures
items.description: HSBC customers who became victims of a long-running "spoofing" scam hope the bank will take full responsibility for its "system failures" in Federal Court this week.

items.title: Homeless woman feels safer living in vehicle than shared housing
items.description: Housing advocates say an increasing number of single, older women are choosing to live in vehicles while they wait for social housing.

items.title: Weaponising homophobia, this Aussie horror is terrifying
items.description: Writer and director Adrian Chiarella's debut supernatural horror feature, Leviticus, is as romantic as it is scary.

items.title: In Peru, I meet a man risking it all to protect the Amazon
items.description: In Peru, I meet a man risking his life to end illegal gold mining in the Amazon, in the hope of saving his beloved town before it's too late.

items.title: Quiz: Grab your suitcase, we're going on a trip
items.description: Which airport hosts the world's largest indoor waterfall? What is the Swiss delicacy raclette?

items.title: KPMG the latest example of accountants being unaccountable
items.description: Bean counters have historically been viewed as dull, dull, dull. But since the turn of the century, accounting scandals have come thick and fast in Australia.

items.title: 'Cut the complexity': Watchdog moves to dramatically simplify power bills
items.description: Millions of Australians have been often unwittingly moved to complex and variable power tariffs. An energy watchdog says bills must be simplified.

items.title: Uni students tackle 'character-building' remote living through placements
items.description: University student Tarhnee says her survival kit for a nursing prac placement was food, a swag, a chair and a little table for her laptop.

items.title: Sydney-to-London unveiled as first route for Qantas's Project Sunrise
items.description: The flights, set to begin take off from next year, will mark the first time flights from the east coast will complete the Kangaroo Route without a stop over.

items.title: Serial killer jailed for life over eight Long Island murders
items.description: A New York architect was sentenced to three consecutive life sentences plus 100 years after pleading guilty to the murders of at least eight women in Long Island's Gilgo Beach.

items.title: Sell-out shows, cult status line-up: How Dark Mofo catapults artists
items.description: Her headline show at Dark Mofo sold out in just over an hour, something Tasmanian Indigenous singer Miss Kaninna says couldn't have happened without the winter festival's ability to attract "massive, massive" music industry names.

items.title: Wanted fugitive fled Australia six days after home raided by NSW Police
items.description: The alleged gunman slipped the net and fled to Lebanon days after he was paid hundreds of thousands of dollars to take out a Sydney underworld figure in 2022.

items.title: Tenants oppose social housing redevelopment advocates say is vital
items.description: The state government wants to replace about 400 social housing properties moments from the beach with a 2,500-apartment development, but tenants say they will not go.
